title_sq: Shesim Apartament 2+1 tek Rruga e Durresit!
description_sq:
Shesim Apartamenti te tipologjise 2+1 ne Rrugen e Durresit, shume prane Prokurorise.
Aktualisht ambienti shfrytezohet ne funksion te tiopoligjise 1+1, duke krijuar hapesiren e kuzhines me vete.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati ekzistues. Ambientet jane te organizuara ne nje korridor shperndares, nje ambient ndenjeje, kuzhina e ndare ne me vete , dhoma e gjumit me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti.
Prona ka investime ekstra te sapo realizuara nga pronari, duke pefshire tualetin si dhe kuzhinen, dhe mobilimi i paperdorur.
Apartamenti shitet ne gjendjen qe eshte pasqyruar ne foto.
Vlera e shitjes do jete ne Leke!
Per detaje shtese apo vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
title_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment on Durres Street!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment on Durres Street, very close to the Prosecutor's Office. Currently, the environment is used as a 1+1 condominium, creating a separate kitchen space. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building. The premises are organized in a distribution corridor, a living room, a separate kitchen, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. The property has extra investments recently made by the owner, including the bathroom as well as the kitchen, and unused furniture. The apartment is sold in the condition shown in the photo. The selling price will be in Lek! For additional details or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
